name: fictura
description: Official hosted MCP interface to Fictura, the AI-native growth data layer for Expo and React Native apps. Coding agents can read real SDK setup, placements, user funnels, subscriptions, A/B experiments, attribution, store analytics and production errors, and create reviewable paywall/onboarding drafts with permission. Live publishing stays in the dashboard.

FICTURA_MCP_KEY.description: Optional Fictura MCP key (Fictura dashboard → Setup → Coding agents) for clients that can't sign in with OAuth. Never commit your key.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in with Fictura, then pick one app and an access level. The docs tools work without signing in.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP with a Fictura MCP key instead of OAuth.
